diagram_math_checks.justification: Statement/Given and proof 1.1 fix p0=(0,0), p1=(2,0), p2=(0,2), x=(1/2,1/2). These exact coordinates are drawn. The triangle is nondegenerate (determinant 4); x has positive coordinates and x1+x2=1<2, so it is strictly interior.

The displayed labels attach (lambda0,lambda1,lambda2)=(1/2,1/4,1/4) to exactly (p0,p1,p2). Their sum is 1 and (1/2)(0,0)+(1/4)(2,0)+(1/4)(0,2)=(1/2,1/2), as in proof 1.1 and the local barycentric definition cited by F3.
The figure assigns (f0,f1,f2)=(0,2,2) in the Given order. Their weighted sum is 0/2+2/4+2/4=1, matching proof 2.1 and the F3 definition of I_Tf.

Proof 3.1 and F2 identify the single triangle for these three noncollinear sites. Only its three sides are asserted, with no Voronoi/circumcircle claims added. The source explicitly draws A--B--C--A; the native SVG path M8.742 72.633h113.81L8.743-41.177v113.81 and standalone crop visibly show all three sides, giving degree 2 at each triangle vertex. The query marker is separate, not another graph vertex or edge.
